title: SA2 – Tier 1 "Licences" (Lebanon · Access) hero: Beirut ministry/civic training room, generative-AI certification, laptops with Athar UI, Athar certificate/wall sign
prompt: Inside a bright civic training room of a Lebanese government ministry in Beirut: tall windows with pale limestone arched frames typical of Beirut public buildings, cream plaster walls, wooden tables arranged in a U-shape. Seven Lebanese professionals of mixed ages (civil servants, a schoolteacher, a nurse in pale blue scrubs, a small-business owner; some women wearing headscarves and some not, men in shirts and knitwear) sit at the tables working on open silver laptops during a generative-AI certification session; a Lebanese woman trainer in a Gulf Blue (#1E3A5F) blazer stands at the front of the room, gesturing as she explains. Over-the-shoulder view from behind two participants in the foreground, so that their laptop screens face the camera and are clearly visible; each laptop screen is a chroma-key green rectangle. On the far wall hangs one large framed certificate whose entire paper area is a chroma-key green rectangle, and next to it a rectangular wall sign panel that is a chroma-key green rectangle. Seated eye-level camera, gentle depth of field, focus on the two foreground participants typing. Ultra-realistic documentary photograph shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens at f/4; natural directional daylight from one side; warm-neutral colour grade (cream, sand and soft parchment tones) with one deep Gulf Blue (#1E3A5F) element anchoring the frame; subtle natural film grain; true-to-life skin texture; accurate anatomy, natural relaxed hands with five fingers; candid, unposed, real people in a real work setting; no stock-photo gloss. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, signage, UI or writing anywhere in the image. Every screen and every blank sign/certificate surface described is a flat, evenly lit, solid chroma-key green (#00B140) rectangle with crisp straight edges and square corners, matte, no reflections, no glare, no green light spill on people or objects. No robots, no holograms, no glowing brains, no neon, no sci-fi effects. Landscape 3:2 composition.
